items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: He would come out before the show and sit on the steps and entertain... He says, Tom, you ready? I says, all right. He says, let's go.

ctx.x: White man. He would have a high derby, a silk hat. And he would come out before the show and sit on the steps and entertain. And then he says, Tom, you ready? I says, all right. He says, let's go. That was stopping the traffic.
